g.text: Match and Tournament teams, planning and shirts
Team selection, match planning and reusable shirts.
Match has exactly one Team; Tournament has one
or more. A Team is a selection in one activity,
not a permanent club team. It needs at least one
optional Tournament overrides of the activity.
The opponent is only a label. The lineup (MatchPlan)
is Match-only; Tournament fixtures and lineups are
Copied from an OfficialMatchFormat on Squad
At most one default per Squad.
Exactly one GK slot and at least one outfield slot.
